name: Minamoto Kurou
source:
Before he was appointed the position of commander of the Clean Keepers he was your average high school student.
Because he was absent the day that the class committee leaders were assigned he was appointed the leader of the beautification committee.
He doesn't hate cleaning. He is serious, but he tends to find things troublesome.
He has a complex about his short height.
